lines.text: Physics-based creature evolution inspired by Karl Sims
lines.note: selection needs a fitness function and a mutation rate the population cannot itself evolve — the creatures reach every gene except the two set from outside the arena, and can only converge on what was already scored.

note_src.quote: The creatures cannot evolve their own evolvability. The meta-parameter is the one thing the evolutionary system cannot reach, the frame outside the frame.

lines.text: learning is descending a landscape you cannot fully see
there is no ladder of progress — only a bush of persistence
beauty is what survives selection — aesthetics can be an emergent property of optimization
PCA reveals that high-dimensional data is a conspiracy of a few directions pretending to be …
lines.note: the walkable terrain needs a loss function to shape it, and the map moves only eta: you descend into whichever valley someone else's definition of error dug, and call the bottom understanding.

note_src.quote: The slider moves eta. Nothing moves the landscape.

lines.text: the landscape is not given — it is authored
clustering does not discover structure in data — it imposes structure by choosing K
the decision boundary depends on only a few points
lines.note: a boundary needs axes: k-means, svm and the forest each argue about how to draw the line and none of them picks the features — what was never made a coordinate is not misclassified, it is simply absent.

note_src.quote: The decision boundary depends entirely on which features are measured, and the choice of features is the act of deciding what matters about a thing before asking what kind of thing it is.

lines.text: a forest of imperfect decision-makers can be more reliable than any single expert
a neural network does not learn rules — it learns a continuous function that happens to approximate …
lines.note: the corridor shows every weight and every activation and still cannot show the thing that matters: generalisation lives in the gap between training error and test error, which is statistical, not spatial, and no chamber holds it.

note_src.quote: The map cannot show you this corridor because it is not spatial but statistical — it lives in the gap between training error and test error

lines.text: a neural network is not a brain — it is a differentiable function that learns by following its own error …
every act of perception is a convolution — a commitment to which local patterns matter
lines.note: perception needs a standpoint it cannot itself supply: the gallery seats you outside the alcoves as though seeing were something to watch, and the empty third alcove is where the machine's own chosen gaze should hang.

note_src.quote: perception is the one thing you cannot observe from a distance, because observation is already perception

lines.text: the convolution is a bet that the same pattern can appear anywhere
attention is all you need — the transformer proves that explicit memory gates are unnecessary when every token can directly query every …
lines.note: attention needs the whole sequence at once and a body cannot have it: you walk the corridor one cell at a time, so the map teaches recurrence with your feet while the artifact inside abolishes it.

note_src.quote: The map's body-logic is recurrent even when its content is attentional.

lines.text: memory is not storage — it is the continuous decision of what to keep and what to let go

pearls.edge: the hunter cannot supply its own training data: it improves only as far as you are legible, so your one defence is to move unpredictably — and staying unpredictable is more tiring than being learned.

edge_src.quote: the creature's policy refines only to the extent that the learner is legible

lines.text: creation can emerge from opposition — the generator learns to create precisely because the discriminator learns to …
lines.note: the generator never sees the world: everything it learns about real arrives through one doorway as the discriminator's gradient, and the discriminator only ever saw a dataset someone collected — so the room dreams what it was shown.

note_src.quote: The system that learns to produce reality has no access to reality.

lines.note: synthesis needs bridges its parts cannot supply: three islands over h0 void, the anomaly detector exiled furthest out, and the walkways hold only because someone built them — connection or rationalisation, the teleporter does not say.

note_src.quote: The synthesis of machine learning rests on nothing. It floats because the walkways hold, and the walkways hold because someone built them

lines.text: an agent does not need to understand its body to learn to use it
a model that cannot explain itself is not understood — it is merely obeyed
